database_path.description: Path to the SQLite database file where Fossil stores repositories and metadata.

root_name.description: Name of the default repository exposed at the root web path (e.g., /home). Use empty string to disable.

port.description: HTTP port the server listens on.

host.description: IP address or hostname to bind the server to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' for local-only access).

webui.description: Enable the built-in web interface (true recommended for most users).

ssl.description: Enable HTTPS (requires valid SSL certificate and key paths).

ssl_cert_path.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (PEM format). Required if SSL is enabled.

ssl_key_path.description: Path to the SSL private key file (PEM format). Required if SSL is enabled.

auto_create.description: Allow creation of new repositories via the web UI.

auth_method.description: Authentication method: 'none' = no login required, 'form' = web-based login, etc.

allowed_ips.description: List of allowed client IP addresses (supports wildcards like '192.168.1.*' or CIDR '10.0.0.0/8'). Empty = allow all.

default_access.description: Default access level for unauthenticated or new users.

users.description: List of authenticated users. Required for secure access (e.g., auth_method = 'form' or 'digest').

password_hash.description: Password hash (e.g., SHA1, bcrypt). Use 'fossil hash' CLI to generate.

comment.description: Optional descriptive comment (e.g., real name or role).

hsts.description: Enable HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) header for HTTPS.

log_file.description: Path to log file (empty string = log only to stderr).

base_url.description: Base URL for the server (e.g., 'https://fossil.example.com/'). Used for absolute links in emails/emails.

local_auth.description: Automatically authenticate local requests (from same machine).

repository_root.description: Base directory for relative repository paths in database (optional; leave empty to use absolute paths only).

cgi.description: Run Fossil in CGI mode instead of standalone HTTP server.

cgi_path.description: Path to CGI executable (used when cgi=true).

proxy.description: Enable support for reverse proxies (X-Forwarded-For, etc.).

compression.description: Enable gzip compression for HTTP responses.

cache.description: Enable Fossil’s internal content cache (improves performance).

cache_size_kb.description: Maximum cache size in KB. 0 = default (~100 MB).

replication.description: Enable experimental repository replication (not for production use).
